transcript: Last night I saw tortoise at Second Stage, a new play about three 20 something's living in Madrid, their old friends reconnecting in one of their garages. One of them is trying to become a DJ, another recently moved back to Madrid, and one is a kindergarten teacher. We see some interpersonal conflicts spurred by frictions of existentialism versus meaning or personal achievement versus relational values. In other words, they're figuring it out. And this play really resonated with me. It's one of those pieces where the events could be seen as someone mundane, but with this, there's a clarity in the characters, in the relationships that we really only get by observing them on a day to day basis. As 20 something figuring it out. I really enjoyed this play and I would definitely recommend it. With that, another program for my collection.
